properties.name: external_dependency replies with a receipt, and a re-declare keeps what it was not passed
properties.rationale: Root cause (fact:root-cause-external-dependency-replies-with-the-whole-manifest-because-the-receipt-shapes-only-node-and-edge-records-2026-10-02), confirmed on main at 293f957: the handler ended ok_json(manifest), the receipt layer recognises node and edge records only, and nothing checked that every write's reply is one; the reply grew 444 to 969 bytes over six declarations. The re-declare (fact:re-declaring-a-dependency-drops-the-resources-description-2026-09-23, eight field occurrences) wrote through a replacing create_node. THE CLASS for the reply: a write whose reply is not a record was exempt from receipts in silence. The membership is now reviewed: a_write_replies_with_a_receipt.rs lists every served write as RECORD, ACKNOWLEDGEMENT or REPORT (with a reason), and a write that joins unclassified fails. Found on the way and fixed: a removal was invisible to revision_of (fact:a-write-that-removes-a-property-reported-nothing-moved-2026-10-03). Left open: a comma inside a feature (fact:a-dependency-feature-containing-a-comma-is-read-back-as-several-2026-10-03). Tests observed failing on main first: a_dependency_declaration_replies_with_a_receipt.rs (measured through --call on the main binary) and a_write_that_removes_a_property_says_what_left_and_keeps_it.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: external_dependency replies with the declared Resource, a revision block (what changed and what was removed, the prior state preserved) and the address baseline, never the whole manifest. A re-declare keeps the components, features, watch, graph_id, declared_in and description it is not passed; [] clears a list and "" stops a watch. revision_of and preserve_prior now see a removed property. Every served write is classified by what its reply carries.
